scope: Outcome-blind reconciliation of checkpoint, code, license, runtime, reference, pairing, and existing execution-manifest evidence for MultiVI, scGLUE, MOFA+, and Seurat WNN. No model artifact, matrix, prediction, evaluator output, development outcome, or sealed outcome was opened.

correction_20260825.why: The 2026-08-24 record asserted that no observed-multiome TaskSpec existed. A standalone TaskSpec was written to config/evaluation/observed_multiome_task.toml at 2026-08-25 01:58:03, after this record. The NO_TASKSPEC clause was therefore false and had to be re-derived rather than left standing.
correction_20260825.found_how: Surfaced on 2026-08-25 by refreshing this record's stale config/models/multimodal_integration.toml pin. The stale pin was masking the deeper staleness: the validator aborted on the pin before it reached the TaskSpec check.
correction_20260825.what_did_not_change: No model disposition moved. All four subjects remain admitted=false, each on two or three independent blockers besides the TaskSpec clause. Five of the six other task_gate facts are unchanged and are now corroborated by the TaskSpec rather than resting on its absence. No authority pin, runtime, execution manifest or per-model contract assertion was altered.
correction_20260825.the_token_was_regrounded_not_lifted: NO_TASKSPEC became TASKSPEC_EXECUTION_BLOCKED in the record status and in all four per-model gates. The conjunct count of every gate is unchanged. The blocker now closes from the standalone TaskSpec's own admission_gates[0] and from observed_multiome_development_gate.toml, which is a stronger authority than absence was.
correction_20260825.why_a_boolean_flip_would_have_been_wrong: task_spec_exists could not simply be set to true. The record checks two paths and the answer differs between them: the canonical registration path config/tasks/observed_multiome.toml is still absent, while the standalone path is present. That asymmetry is deliberate -- observed_multiome_task_capabilities.toml states the task is kept outside config/tasks so it cannot mutate the frozen global census or historical audit hashes. A single boolean flip would have asserted the task was registered when its location exists precisely to ensure it is not, and would have contradicted the tournament's still-correct planned_registration.
correction_20260825.status_fields_do_not_conflict: observed_multiome_task.toml status='candidate' and family_native_tournament.toml [task.observed_multiome] status='planned_registration' describe different axes and are simultaneously correct. TaskSpec document status takes only {candidate, blocked} across all nine specs; tournament task status takes only {active, planned_registration, planned_activation_audit, compound} across all seven entries. The value sets are disjoint, and rna_conditioned_atac and variant_to_regulation each carry both at once (TaskSpec candidate, tournament active), which proves 'candidate' makes no claim about registration. registry_status_observed is unchanged.
correction_20260825.ordering_evidence_that_the_dispositions_: observed_multiome_development_gate.toml written 2026-08-25 01:57:21, observed_multiome_task.toml 01:58:03, observed_multiome_task_capabilities.toml 01:58:03. The additive observed-multiome census executions/model-check-288-21098630 ran at 04:10:39, two hours and twelve minutes later, in a world where the TaskSpec already existed, and still recorded execution_authorized=false, candidate_fixture_requirement_satisfied=false and external_seal_bound=false. A later independent authority looked at the same world with the TaskSpec present and reached this record's conclusion.

why_this_is_a_correction_not_a_reassessm: Only multivi is a registered observed-multiome candidate and only seurat_wnn is a registered baseline. scGLUE and MOFA+ appear in no observed-multiome authority at all -- not the standalone TaskSpec, the capabilities file, the development gate, family_native_tournament, or the additive census candidate list. For half the subjects the TaskSpec's existence changes nothing, and for the other half it changes registration rather than admission. No model was reassessed.
